blocks.text: must, mustn't, needn't — majburiyat, taqiq va erkinlik

Bu uch shaklni qizil kitobdan bilasiz (→ qizil kitob, 31-dars): **must** — «kerak, shart», **mustn't** — «mumkin emas, qilmang», **needn't** / **don't need to** — «shart emas». **must** va **have to** farqi hamda **mustn't** va **don't have to** qarama-qarshiligi 31-darsda ko'rildi (→ 31-dars). Bu darsda asosiy e'tibor ikki narsaga qaratiladi: **needn't** qanday modal fe'l ekani va o'tmishdagi ikki nozik shakl — **needn't have done** («qildim, lekin keragi yo'q ekan») va **didn't need to** («kerak bo'lmadi»).

items.text: We **must** remember to renew the car insurance this month.
items.translation: Bu oy mashina sug'urtasini yangilashni **unutmasligimiz kerak**.

items.text: You **mustn't** leave your bag unattended at the airport.
You **needn't** call back — I've already found the answer.
items.translation: Qayta **qo'ng'iroq qilishingiz shart emas** — javobni allaqachon topdim.

blocks.text: mustn't va needn't: qizil chiroq va yashil chiroq

Ikkalasi ham inkor shaklida, lekin ma'nosi butunlay qarama-qarshi. **mustn't** — «buni **qilmang**»: harakat taqiqlangan, qilsangiz xato yoki xavfli bo'ladi. **needn't** — «buni **qilish shart emas**»: qilmasangiz ham bo'ladi, qilsangiz ham xato emas, tanlov sizda. O'zbekchada farq aniq eshitiladi: «Unga **aytma**!» (mustn't) va «Unga **aytishing shart emas**» (needn't). Ingliz tilida ham shunchalik aniq ajrating: **must** ning ma'nodagi inkori «shart emas» emas, balki «qilma».

items.text: You **mustn't** drink this water — it isn't safe.
You **needn't** boil this water — it comes from a filter.
items.translation: Bu suvni **qaynatishingiz shart emas** — u filtrdan o'tgan.

items.text: Children **mustn't** play near the river, but they **needn't** stay indoors all day.
items.translation: Bolalar daryo yaqinida **o'ynamasligi kerak**, lekin kun bo'yi uyda **o'tirishlari shart emas**.

blocks.text: needn't — modal fe'l, need to — oddiy fe'l

**needn't** va **don't need to** ning ma'nosi bir xil, farq — grammatikada. **needn't** modal fe'l kabi ishlaydi: undan keyin `to` yo'q, uchinchi shaxsda `-s` qo'shilmaydi, yordamchi **do** kerak emas: He **needn't** worry. **need to** esa oddiy fe'l: He **doesn't need to** worry, **Do** I **need to** ...?, She **needs to** ... . Darak gapda faqat **need to** ishlatiladi: «I need go» emas, **I need to go**. Og'zaki nutqda **don't need to** ko'proq uchraydi, **needn't** esa biroz rasmiyroq va ko'proq British English'ga xos.

**Need I ...?** shakli kam ishlatiladi va rasmiy eshitiladi. U asosan turg'un iboralarda qolgan: **Need I say more?** — «Yana nima deyish kerak?», **Need I remind you ...?** — «Eslatib o'tishim shartmi...?» (norozilik ohangida). Kundalik savolda: **Do I need to ...?**

**needn't have** + V3 o'tmishdagi harakat **bajarilganini**, lekin keyin u **keraksiz bo'lib chiqqanini** bildiradi. Ko'pincha afsus, kulgi yoki minnatdorchilik ohangida aytiladi. O'zbekchaga «**-shim shart emas ekan**», «**-masam ham bo'lar ekan**», «**bekorga** ...ibman» deb tarjima qilinadi. Mehmon sovg'a olib kelganda aytiladigan **You needn't have!** — «Ovora bo'lmasangiz bo'lardi-ku!» — juda tabiiy xushmuomala ibora.

items.text: I **needn't have cooked** so much — only three people came.
items.translation: Shuncha ko'p **ovqat qilmasam ham bo'lar ekan** — atigi uch kishi keldi.

items.text: You **needn't have brought** a present, but thank you!
items.translation: Sovg'a **olib kelishingiz shart emas edi**, lekin rahmat!

items.text: We **needn't have booked** in advance — the restaurant was half empty.
items.translation: Oldindan **band qilmasak ham bo'lar ekan** — restoran yarim bo'sh edi.

blocks.text: **didn't need to** + fe'l esa shunchaki o'sha paytda harakat **zarur bo'lmaganini** aytadi. Odatda bu harakat **qilinmagan** bo'ladi: I **didn't need to** take a taxi, so I walked. Lekin kontekst boshqacha bo'lishi ham mumkin: I **didn't need to** take a taxi, but I took one because I was tired — kerak emasdi, ammo baribir qildim. **needn't have done** da esa harakat har doim qilingan: bu shaklning butun ma'nosi shunda.

rows: I **didn't need to** iron my shirt — I wore a sweater.
I **needn't have ironed** my shirt — nobody saw it under my jacket.

items.text: Our flight was direct, so we **didn't need to** change planes.
items.translation: Reysimiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri edi, shuning uchun samolyot **almashtirishimiz kerak bo'lmadi**.

items.text: We changed money at the airport, but we **needn't have done** — the hotel had a much better rate.
items.translation: Aeroportda pul almashtirdik, lekin **shart emas ekan** — mehmonxonada kurs ancha yaxshi edi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He needn't to come» → He **needn't come** yoki He **doesn't need to come** (`needn't` dan keyin `to` yo'q, `need to` da esa shart); «You mustn't come tomorrow» deb «ertaga kelishingiz shart emas» demoqchi bo'lish → You **needn't** / **don't have to** come tomorrow (`mustn't` — taqiq!); «I needn't have gone» ni «bormadim» ma'nosida ishlatish → bu shakl **bordim, lekin keragi yo'q ekan** degani, bormagan bo'lsangiz — I **didn't need to** go; «He need to rest» → He **needs to** rest (oddiy fe'l sifatida `-s` oladi).

Eslab qolish: **mustn't** — qizil chiroq (to'xta, mumkin emas), **needn't** — yashil chiroq (xohlasang o't, xohlamasang yo'q). **needn't have done** ni o'zbekcha «**bekorga** ...ibman» bilan tekshiring: «Bekorga shoshibman» degan ma'no to'g'ri kelsa — I **needn't have hurried**.

rows: I **must** go to the bank today.

examples.title: **must**: it's necessary
examples.description: must — so'zlovchi buni zarur yoki juda muhim deb hisoblaydi; qoida va rasmiy ko'rsatmalarda ham ishlatiladi.

sentences.text: I **must** call my grandmother tonight — it's her birthday tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun buvimga **qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak** — ertaga uning tug'ilgan kuni.

sentences.text: You **must** see the new exhibition at the museum; it's absolutely brilliant.
sentences.translation: Muzeydagi yangi ko'rgazmani albatta **ko'rishingiz kerak**, u juda ajoyib.

sentences.text: Passengers **must** show their boarding passes at the gate.
sentences.translation: Yo'lovchilar chiqish eshigida bortga chiqish talonini **ko'rsatishlari shart**.

sentences.text: We **must** leave by six, otherwise we'll get stuck in traffic.
sentences.translation: Soat oltigacha **chiqib ketishimiz kerak**, aks holda tirbandlikda qolib ketamiz.

sentences.text: Madina **must** finish her report today because her manager is flying to London tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Madina hisobotini bugun **tugatishi kerak**, chunki rahbari ertaga Londonga uchib ketadi.

sentences.text: All visitors **must** wear a helmet on the building site.
sentences.translation: Qurilish maydonida barcha tashrif buyuruvchilar **dubulg'a kiyishi shart**.

sentences.text: Honestly, this podcast about sleep is fantastic — you **must** listen to it.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, uyqu haqidagi bu podkast ajoyib — albatta **eshitib ko'rishingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: **Must** I bring my passport to the bank, or is my ID card enough?
sentences.translation: Bankka pasportimni olib **borishim shartmi** yoki ID karta yetarlimi?

sentences.text: The doctor says Aziz **must** stop smoking if he wants to stay healthy.
sentences.translation: Shifokorning aytishicha, Aziz sog'lom bo'lishni istasa, chekishni **tashlashi kerak**.

sentences.text: Students **must** submit their essays online before midnight on Friday.
sentences.translation: Talabalar inshoni juma kuni yarim tungacha onlayn **topshirishlari shart**.

examples.title: **mustn't**: don't do it!
examples.description: mustn't — taqiq yoki qat'iy ogohlantirish: bu harakatni qilish mumkin emas, xato yoki xavfli.

sentences.text: You **mustn't** tell anyone about the surprise party for Kate.
sentences.translation: Keyt uchun tayyorlanayotgan kutilmagan bazm haqida hech kimga **aytish mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: We **mustn't** forget to switch off the gas before we leave.
sentences.translation: Ketishdan oldin gazni o'chirishni **unutmasligimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Drivers **mustn't** use their phones while the car is moving.
sentences.translation: Mashina harakatlanayotganda haydovchilar telefondan **foydalanmasligi shart**.

sentences.text: I **mustn't** eat too much tonight — I've got a medical check-up in the morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun ko'p **yemasligim kerak** — ertalab tibbiy ko'rikdan o'taman.

sentences.text: Students **mustn't** use dictionaries during the exam.
sentences.translation: Imtihon paytida talabalarga lug'atdan **foydalanish mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: This medicine is strong, so you **mustn't** take more than two tablets a day.
sentences.translation: Bu dori kuchli, shuning uchun kuniga ikki tabletkadan **ko'p ichmang**.

sentences.text: Remember, Jasur, you **mustn't** be late on your first day at the new office.
sentences.translation: Esingda bo'lsin, Jasur, yangi ofisdagi birinchi kuningda **kechikmasliging kerak**.

sentences.text: The baby is finally asleep, so we **mustn't** make any noise.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq nihoyat uxladi, shuning uchun **shovqin qilmasligimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Visitors **mustn't** touch the old manuscripts in this part of the library.
sentences.translation: Tashrif buyuruvchilar kutubxonaning bu qismidagi qadimiy qo'lyozmalarga **tegmasligi shart**.

sentences.text: Your password is personal — you **mustn't** share it with anyone, even colleagues.
sentences.translation: Parolingiz shaxsiy — uni hech kimga, hatto hamkasblaringizga ham **bermasligingiz kerak**.

examples.title: **needn't** / **don't need to**: it isn't necessary
examples.description: needn't va don't need to — bir xil ma'no: zarurat yo'q, qilmasangiz ham bo'ladi. needn't dan keyin to yo'q, need to esa oddiy fe'l kabi tuslanadi.

sentences.text: You **needn't** bring anything to the party — we've got plenty of food.
sentences.translation: Bazmga hech narsa **olib kelishingiz shart emas** — ovqat yetarli.

sentences.text: We **don't need to** hurry; the film doesn't start until eight.
sentences.translation: **Shoshilishimiz shart emas**, film soat sakkizda boshlanadi.

sentences.text: Tom **needn't** come to the meeting if he's busy — I'll send him the notes.
sentences.translation: Agar band bo'lsa, Tom yig'ilishga **kelmasa ham bo'ladi** — qaydlarni o'zim yuboraman.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **doesn't need to** buy a new laptop; hers just needs a new battery.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaga yangi noutbuk **sotib olish shart emas**, unikiga faqat yangi batareya kerak.

sentences.text: Don't worry, you **needn't** pay now — you can pay when you collect the photos.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, hozir **to'lashingiz shart emas** — suratlarni olganingizda to'lasangiz bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The flat is already clean, so the cleaner **doesn't need to** come this week.
sentences.translation: Kvartira allaqachon toza, shuning uchun bu hafta tozalovchi ayolning **kelishi shart emas**.

sentences.text: You **don't need to** print the tickets; just show them on your phone.
sentences.translation: Chiptalarni **chop etishingiz shart emas**, telefoningizda ko'rsatsangiz kifoya.

sentences.text: Bekzod speaks fluent English, so he **needn't** take the language test.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ingliz tilida ravon gapiradi, shuning uchun til imtihonini **topshirishi shart emas**.

sentences.text: There's a lift in the building, so we **don't need to** carry the sofa upstairs.
sentences.translation: Binoda lift bor, shuning uchun divanni yuqoriga **ko'tarib chiqishimiz shart emas**.

sentences.text: If you're tired, you **needn't** cook tonight — let's order a pizza.
sentences.translation: Charchagan bo'lsang, bugun **ovqat qilishing shart emas** — pitsa buyurtma qilamiz.

examples.title: **mustn't** or **needn't**? Forbidden or optional
examples.description: Bir gapda ikkalasi: mustn't — taqiq (qilmang), needn't — erkinlik (shart emas). Farqni his qilish uchun.

sentences.text: You **mustn't** park here, but you **needn't** pay for the car park behind the hotel.
sentences.translation: Bu yerga mashina **qo'yish mumkin emas**, lekin mehmonxona orqasidagi to'xtash joyi uchun **pul to'lash shart emas**.

sentences.text: We **needn't** wear suits to the office party, but we **mustn't** arrive late.
sentences.translation: Ofis bazmiga kostyum **kiyishimiz shart emas**, lekin **kechikib kelmasligimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Patients **mustn't** eat before the blood test, but they **needn't** stop drinking water.
sentences.translation: Qon tahlilidan oldin bemorlar **ovqat yemasligi kerak**, lekin suv ichishni **to'xtatishlari shart emas**.

sentences.text: Tell the kids they **needn't** tidy their rooms today, but they **mustn't** touch my computer.
sentences.translation: Bolalarga ayt, bugun xonalarini **yig'ishtirishlari shart emas**, lekin kompyuterimga **tegmasliklari kerak**.

sentences.text: In this library readers **mustn't** talk loudly, though they **needn't** be completely silent.
sentences.translation: Bu kutubxonada kitobxonlar **baland ovozda gaplashmasligi kerak**, ammo butunlay jim **o'tirishlari shart emas**.

sentences.text: Kate **needn't** reply to the email today, but she **mustn't** forget about it.
sentences.translation: Keyt xatga bugun **javob berishi shart emas**, lekin uni **unutmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: Students **needn't** come to the lecture on Friday, but they **mustn't** miss the seminar.
sentences.translation: Talabalar juma kungi ma'ruzaga **kelmasa ham bo'ladi**, lekin seminarni **qoldirmasliklari kerak**.

sentences.text: It's a secret, so you **mustn't** tell Madina, but you **needn't** lie to her either.
sentences.translation: Bu sir, shuning uchun Madinaga **aytmasligingiz kerak**, lekin unga yolg'on **gapirishingiz ham shart emas**.

sentences.text: At this hotel guests **needn't** check out until midday, but they **mustn't** smoke in the rooms.
sentences.translation: Bu mehmonxonada mehmonlar tushgacha **xonani bo'shatishlari shart emas**, lekin xonalarda **chekish mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: Visitors to the factory **mustn't** go near the machines, but they **needn't** wear special clothes.
sentences.translation: Zavodga kelganlar dastgohlar yoniga **yaqinlashmasligi kerak**, lekin maxsus kiyim **kiyishlari shart emas**.

examples.title: Questions: **Do I need to ...?**
examples.description: Zarurat haqida savol — Do I need to ...? (kundalik shakl). Need I ...? — kam va rasmiy, asosan turg'un iboralarda. Savol → javob juftliklari.

sentences.text: **Do I need to** book a table, or can we just turn up? — You don't need to on weekdays.
sentences.translation: Stol **band qilishim kerakmi** yoki shunchaki kelaveramizmi? — Ish kunlari shart emas.

sentences.text: **Does** Oliver **need to** bring his own laptop to the course? — No, he needn't; the college provides them.
sentences.translation: Oliver kursga o'z noutbukini **olib kelishi kerakmi**? — Yo'q, shart emas, kollej beradi.

sentences.text: **Do we need to** change trains in Manchester? — No, this one goes straight to Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Manchesterda poyezd **almashtirishimiz kerakmi**? — Yo'q, bu poyezd to'g'ri Edinburgga boradi.

sentences.text: What documents **do** I **need to** take to the visa office? — Just your passport and two photos.
sentences.translation: Viza bo'limiga qanday hujjatlarni **olib borishim kerak**? — Faqat pasport va ikkita surat.

sentences.text: **Need** I say more? Everyone already knows how hard Nilufar worked on this.
sentences.translation: Yana nima **deyishim kerak**? Nilufarning bu ish ustida qanchalik mehnat qilganini hamma biladi.

sentences.text: **Do** you **need** me **to** pick you up from the station? — No, thanks, Aziz is meeting me.
sentences.translation: Sizni bekatdan **olib ketishim kerakmi**? — Yo'q, rahmat, Aziz kutib oladi.

sentences.text: Is it necessary to wear a tie? — No, you **needn't**; smart jeans are fine.
sentences.translation: Galstuk taqish shartmi? — Yo'q, **shart emas**, chiroyli jinsi shim ham bo'laveradi.

sentences.text: How early **does** Sarah **need to** be at the airport for an international flight?
sentences.translation: Xalqaro reys uchun Sara aeroportga qancha erta **borishi kerak**?

sentences.text: Why **do** we **need to** fill in this form again? — Because the first one was lost.
sentences.translation: Nega bu anketani yana **to'ldirishimiz kerak**? — Chunki birinchisi yo'qolib qolgan.

sentences.text: Will I **need to** take the whole exam again if I fail one part? — No, only that part.
sentences.translation: Bitta qismidan o'ta olmasam, butun imtihonni qaytadan **topshirishim kerak bo'ladimi**? — Yo'q, faqat o'sha qismni.

examples.title: **needn't have done**: you did it, but it wasn't necessary
examples.description: needn't have + V3 — harakat bajarilgan, lekin keyin keraksiz bo'lib chiqqan. O'zbekchada «-shim shart emas ekan», «bekorga ...».

sentences.text: I **needn't have taken** my umbrella to Bukhara — it didn't rain once.
sentences.translation: Buxoroga soyabonimni **olib borishim shart emas ekan** — bir marta ham yomg'ir yog'madi.

sentences.text: We **needn't have hurried**: the train was twenty minutes late.
sentences.translation: **Shoshilmasak ham bo'lar ekan** — poyezd yigirma daqiqa kechikdi.

sentences.text: You **needn't have bought** me flowers, but it's very kind of you.
sentences.translation: Menga gul **olishingiz shart emas edi**, lekin juda mehribonlik qildingiz.

sentences.text: Emma **needn't have worried** about the interview — they offered her the job the same day.
sentences.translation: Emma suhbatdan **bekorga xavotir olgan ekan** — o'sha kuniyoq unga ishni taklif qilishdi.

sentences.text: They **needn't have cooked** so much plov; half the guests didn't come.
sentences.translation: Shuncha ko'p palov **damlashlari shart emas ekan** — mehmonlarning yarmi kelmadi.

sentences.text: Jasur **needn't have printed** all the documents, because the manager only wanted them by email.
sentences.translation: Jasur hamma hujjatlarni **chop etmasa ham bo'lardi**, chunki rahbar ularni faqat elektron pochtada so'ragan edi.

sentences.text: Oh, you **needn't have washed** the dishes — we've got a dishwasher!
sentences.translation: Voy, idishlarni **yuvishingiz shart emas edi** — bizda idish yuvish mashinasi bor-ku!

sentences.text: In the end I **needn't have revised** the whole book, because the test only covered two chapters.
sentences.translation: Oxir-oqibat butun kitobni **takrorlashim shart emas ekan**, chunki test faqat ikki bobdan edi.

sentences.text: Kate took a taxi to the station, but she **needn't have done** — it's only a five-minute walk.
sentences.translation: Keyt bekatga taksida bordi, lekin bunga **hojat yo'q edi** — u yergacha piyoda besh daqiqalik yo'l.

sentences.text: Looking back, Madina **needn't have spent** so much money on her wedding dress.
sentences.translation: Hozir o'ylasa, Madina to'y libosiga shuncha pul **sarflamasa ham bo'lar ekan**.

examples.title: **didn't need to** or **needn't have done**?
examples.description: didn't need to — zarurat bo'lmadi (odatda harakat qilinmagan). needn't have done — harakat qilingan, lekin keraksiz ekan. Juftliklarda solishtiring.

sentences.text: I **didn't need to** wake up early, so I slept until ten.
sentences.translation: Erta **turishim shart emas edi**, shuning uchun soat o'ngacha uxladim.

sentences.text: I got up at six, but I **needn't have done** — the meeting was cancelled.
sentences.translation: Soat oltida turdim, lekin bunga **hojat yo'q ekan** — yig'ilish bekor qilinibdi.

sentences.text: We **didn't need to** take a taxi because Bekzod drove us home.
sentences.translation: Taksiga **o'tirishimiz kerak bo'lmadi**, chunki Bekzod bizni uyga mashinada olib bordi.

sentences.text: We took a taxi, but we **needn't have done**; the hotel was just around the corner.
sentences.translation: Taksiga o'tirdik, lekin **shart emas ekan** — mehmonxona shundoqqina burilishda ekan.

sentences.text: Sarah **didn't need to** get a visa for Georgia, so she booked the trip the same day.
sentences.translation: Saraga Gruziya uchun **viza olish kerak bo'lmadi**, shuning uchun sayohatni o'sha kuniyoq band qildi.

sentences.text: James applied for a visa, but he **needn't have bothered** — the rules had changed a week earlier.
sentences.translation: Jeyms vizaga hujjat topshirdi, lekin **ovora bo'lmasa ham bo'lar ekan** — qoidalar bir hafta oldin o'zgargan edi.

sentences.text: Thanks to the online form, Nilufar **didn't need to** queue at the tax office.
sentences.translation: Onlayn anketa tufayli Nilufarga soliq idorasida **navbatda turish kerak bo'lmadi**.

sentences.text: **Did** you **need to** show your ID at the entrance? — No, they just checked our tickets.
sentences.translation: Kirishda **hujjatingizni ko'rsatishingiz kerak bo'ldimi**? — Yo'q, faqat chiptalarimizni tekshirishdi.

sentences.text: The repair was free, so in the end Aziz **didn't need to** pay a penny.
sentences.translation: Ta'mir bepul ekan, shuning uchun oxir-oqibat Azizga bir tiyin ham **to'lash kerak bo'lmadi**.

sentences.text: Oliver revised all weekend, although he **didn't need to** — he already knew the material perfectly.
sentences.translation: Oliver butun dam olish kunlari takrorladi, garchi bunga **ehtiyoj bo'lmasa ham** — u mavzuni allaqachon a'lo bilardi.

examples.title: Mixed: rules, freedom and wasted effort
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: must, mustn't, needn't / don't need to, didn't need to va needn't have done — kontekstli gaplarda.

sentences.text: You **must** register for the conference by Friday, but you **needn't** pay until March.
sentences.translation: Konferensiyaga juma kunigacha **ro'yxatdan o'tishingiz kerak**, lekin martgacha **to'lashingiz shart emas**.

sentences.text: Doctors say that people with high blood pressure **mustn't** eat too much salt.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlarning aytishicha, qon bosimi baland odamlar ko'p tuz **yemasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: Thank you for the lift, but you really **needn't have waited** for me in the rain.
sentences.translation: Olib ketganingiz uchun rahmat, lekin meni yomg'irda **kutib turishingiz shart emas edi**.

sentences.text: Nobody **needs to** know about this mistake as long as we fix it today.
sentences.translation: Agar bugun tuzatsak, bu xato haqida hech kim **bilishi shart emas**.

sentences.text: Before the flight we **must** check whether the airline allows power banks in hand luggage.
sentences.translation: Parvozdan oldin aviakompaniya qo'l yukida power bank olib o'tishga ruxsat beradimi-yo'qmi, **tekshirishimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Luckily the shop had my size, so I **didn't need to** order the boots online.
sentences.translation: Yaxshiyamki, do'konda mening o'lchamim bor ekan, shuning uchun etikni onlayn **buyurtma qilishim kerak bo'lmadi**.

sentences.text: Employees **mustn't** share client data on social media under any circumstances.
sentences.translation: Xodimlar hech qanday holatda mijozlar ma'lumotlarini ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda **ulashmasligi shart**.

sentences.text: Grandma **needn't have made** a cake, because we'd already bought one from the bakery.
sentences.translation: Buvim tort **pishirmasa ham bo'lar ekan**, chunki biz novvoyxonadan bittasini sotib olib bo'lgan edik.

sentences.text: With the new app, customers **don't need to** visit the bank to open an account.
sentences.translation: Yangi ilova bilan mijozlar hisob ochish uchun bankka **borishlari shart emas**.

sentences.text: **Must** we really go to Emma's party? — Yes, we must; we promised her weeks ago.
sentences.translation: Emmaning bazmiga rostdan ham **borishimiz shartmi**? — Ha, shart, unga bir necha hafta oldin va'da bergan edik.
